messages:
maia: Quick sync — PRD acceptance for trace retention UX. I added a canary fallback section but need clarity on rollout risk tolerances. TL;DR: do we want hard max retention 30d for free tier and 90d for enterprise, or soft limits with upgrade prompts?
jordan: i'd lean soft limits + clear inline CTA. Hard limits create support churn. also need to call out long-tail cost calc (tokens/day * retention)
samir: agree soft limits. add acceptance test: when user toggles retention >30d on free plan UI should show cost estimate modal and require confirmation. example text in PRD draft.
cesar: is there a metric for allowed spike before canary fallback? e.g., sustained 2x baseline for 5m -> trigger fallback to reduced sampling?
ellie: yes, we have two thresholds in the runtime team: spike_threshold=2.0, spike_window=300s. but UX needs graceful messaging: "we're reducing retention temporarily to protect latency".
maia: perfect — i'll add those exact params. acceptance checklist item: 
```
- simulate traffic 2x baseline for 10m -> verify fallback engages within 5m
- verify user sees modal with cost delta when increasing retention
- verify audit log entry created for retention change
```
(just short smoke tests)
jordan: small edge-case: what if user is on Dedicated with SLA that disallows fallback? need an opt-out flag on the org config. PRD should require opt_out_for_sla boolean with admin guard.
samir: added: "opt_out_for_sla=true" prevents automated fallback; in that case alerts should escalate to oncall and UI shows guidance to contact support.
deploy-bot: Canary policy deployed to staging at 1837654500 :rocket:
maia: thanks — can someone review the phrasing on the user-facing modal? pasted draft below:
"Extending trace retention will increase storage costs and may affect system performance during spikes. Confirm to proceed."
cesar: tweak: "Extending trace retention increases storage costs. During traffic spikes we may temporarily shorten retention to maintain latency SLOs. Confirm to proceed." makes intent clearer.
ellie: +1. Also add link to billing calc: /console/billing/retention-estimator
maia: great. i'll update PRD and ping for final signoff tomorrow. meeting to finalize? 10am PT?
jordan: +1
samir: on calendar
maia: thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
